cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Dispatch handed it to transport without a receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The birthday invitations failed during address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The archive supplied an outdated location.

cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Tell the children the trip's postponed for bus repairs. They'll worry about Mr Patel. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then everyone says, 'Mr Patel is fine; the bus needs repairs.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Same sentence for the office. We don't need three versions of his afternoon.

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the children the trip's postponed for bus repairs. They'll worry about Mr Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then everyone says, 'Mr Patel is fine; the bus needs repairs.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Same sentence for the office. We don't need three versions of his afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Let's tell everyone the party moved indoors because the garden's unavailable.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: That's his opening sentence too. Then straight to thanking her for the trifle.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing to serve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which matches our rejection of the entire cake. I'll record that as full customer agreement with quality control.

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing to serve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which matches our rejection of the entire cake. I'll record that as full customer agreement with quality control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're locked in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then everyone reached the designated assembly point and nobody wandered off. Full compliance.

beats.text: I can't reach the door handle with all twelve of us in here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twelve accounted for, with nobody able to leave before the headcount. That's both final checks passed.
